claims: The 2026 MLB season opens on Wednesday, March 25.
New York Yankees vs. San Francisco Giants at Oracle Park on Wednesday, March 25, 2026, at 8:05 p.m. ET.
New York Yankees vs. San Francisco Giants game streams exclusively on Netflix.
Traditional Opening Day is on Thursday, March 26, 2026.
Dodgers host the Diamondbacks on March 26, 2026.
Remainder of the league starts by Friday, March 27, 2026.
Pitching matchups include Max Fried (NYY) vs. Logan Webb (SF).
Pitching matchups include Zac Gallen (AZ) vs. Yoshinobu Yamamoto (LAD).
D-backs and Padres play in the Mexico City Series on April 25-26, 2026.
Pittsburgh Pirates at New York Mets on March 26, 2026, at 1:15 p.m. ET on NBC/Peacock.
2026 MLB All-Star Game is on July 14 at Citizens Bank Park, Philadelphia.
